---
title: "TrailPulse — Local Trail Conditions"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
source("R/setup.R")
library(yaml)
library(glue)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

all_parks <- yaml::read_yaml("data/parks.yml")[["parks"]]
```

> **Updated daily.** Conditions are estimated from weather data and soil moisture models — not a substitute for official trail closures.

```{r park-cards}
#| output: asis

card_html <- purrr::map_chr(all_parks, function(p) {
  park_url   <- paste0("parks/", p$id, "/index.html")
  activities <- if (!is.null(p$activities))
    paste(stringr::str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", p$activities)), collapse = " \u00b7 ")
  else ""

  glue::glue(
    '<a href="{park_url}" class="tp-park-card" style="display:block;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;">',
    '  <div class="park-name">{p$name}</div>',
    '  <div class="park-location">{p$location}</div>',
    '  <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#555;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">{p$description}</div>',
    '  <div style="margin-top:0.75rem;font-size:0.8rem;color:#777;">{activities}</div>',
    '</a>',
    .sep = "\n"
  )
})

cat('<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem;">\n')
cat(paste(card_html, collapse = "\n"))
cat('\n</div>\n')
```

---

*Trail condition data sourced from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com), [USGS National Water Information System](https://waterdata.usgs.gov), and [NWS](https://www.weather.gov). Not affiliated with Erie County Parks or any land management authority.*
